hooks.name: Pre-commit secret, remote URL, and document-text logging scan
hooks.description: Before a git commit, scan the staged diff for API keys, disallowed remote URLs in extension code, and console logging of document text or secrets; block the commit if found.

action.command: $raw=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if($raw -notmatch 'git\s+commit'){exit 0}; $f=git diff --cached --name-only 2>$null | Where-Object {$_ -match '^(apps/extension|packages/)'}; if(-not $f){exit 0}; $d=git diff --cached -- @($f) 2>$null; if(-not $d){exit 0}; $k=$d | Select-String -Pattern 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}','api[_-]?key\s*[:=]\s*["''][^"'']{8,}'; $l=$d | Select-String -Pattern 'console\.(log|error|warn|info|debug)[^\n;]*(extractedText|documentText|apiKey|secret|token|password)'; $u=$d | Select-String -Pattern 'https?://(?!.*(anthropic|openai|generativelanguage|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1))'; if($k -or $l -or $u){[Console]::Error.WriteLine('Specter pre-commit blocked: possible API key, disallowed remote URL, or sensitive logging in staged extension code.'); exit 2}
